scope: Initial performance investigation after the Id cleanup; no runtime optimization implemented or speedup claimed.
measurement_limits: Concurrent unrelated LLVM and Go builds plus another active application were observed; CPU and elapsed times are recorded separately. These are diagnostic observations, not an uncontended release benchmark or before/after speed comparison.
Language phase samples are six observations across two fresh processes, with normal automatic GC. Timers exclude startup, source loading, warmup, explicit pre-sample collection and printing.

Allocation measurements disable automatic collection for one bounded operation and include a small amount of observation overhead. No-auto-GC timings are diagnostic and are not candidate performance claims.

Native samples cover three-second windows. Sample percentages are not guaranteed optimization speedups. The startup sample was taken during installer startup verification; the loop sample followed its readiness marker while the installer was still preparing its tools image.
The Logue quiet case checks four state checkpoints against the independent oracle. The full Logue regression and other benchmark cases were not run.

native_send.description: One million current Id sends to the bootstrap yourself implementation, no language frame/loop and no GC; five repetitions after warmup. It is not equivalent work to a language method invocation.

prioritized_opportunities.candidate: Avoid unconditional full registration scans when no retirement is pending.
prioritized_opportunities.evidence: Invocation::drop has 156 of 1591 leaf samples (9.8%) in the loop profile. end_managed_turn scans every registration whenever depth returns to zero, irrespective of whether anything is retiring.
prioritized_opportunities.direction: First investigate using existing Execution pending-retirement bookkeeping to skip empty work. Preserve retirement ordering, acquired entries, frame/continuation pins, explicit leases and nested managed turns. No Id change is needed.
prioritized_opportunities.status: Source-confirmed unnecessary scan; candidate speedup not measured.

prioritized_opportunities.candidate: Reduce allocation and copying in execution/control transfers.
prioritized_opportunities.evidence: The empty Integer loop creates about 357 objects per iteration; Range creates about 467. Range crosses the unchanged 16 MiB GC budget. Its median CPU falls from 1369 ms with normal GC to 665 ms with automatic GC disabled; explicit collection afterward costs 751 ms.
prioritized_opportunities.direction: Trace which temporary objects and argument copies are avoidable. Preserve escaped continuation identity, late-reply rejection, scheduling boundaries and call roots; do not pool visible continuation objects or fuse observable control steps without proving the contract.
prioritized_opportunities.status: Allocation/GC cost measured; individual allocation sites not yet counted.

prioritized_opportunities.candidate: Reduce byte-at-a-time transfer work during image restoration.
prioritized_opportunities.evidence: One TCC read_bytes subtree accounts for 693 of 2286 startup-window samples (30.3%). The helper sends sizeWord then atWord: once per byte.
prioritized_opportunities.direction: Investigate redundant transfers and representation-owner data operations above Id. Preserve replaceable byte operations; raw foreign payload access or a renamed application/forwarding protocol is not an acceptable shortcut.
prioritized_opportunities.status: Concrete hot path; bulk-operation semantics need review before implementation.

prioritized_opportunities.candidate: Reduce eagerly emitted native object code in images.
prioritized_opportunities.evidence: Bootstrap stores 4308 objects for 2154 programs; tools stores 6012 for 3006. Both synchronous and resumable versions are emitted for every program. The code record is about 94% of each image. No byte-identical object duplicates were found.
prioritized_opportunities.direction: Determine which representations must be prepared and how much repeated scaffolding can be removed while retaining source-free execution, image portability and optimizer/deoptimization support. Do not assume one execution convention can simply be deleted.
prioritized_opportunities.status: Storage composition measured; requires broader design review than the first candidate.
